summary: Vietnam has issued e-visas to citizens of all countries and territories since 15 August 2023 — 25 USD single entry or 50 USD multiple entry, valid for up to 90 days. Government resolutions exempt citizens of countries including the UK, Germany, France, Japan, South Korea and Switzerland from visas for stays of 45 days.

tips.text: Apply for the e-visa only at evisa.gov.vn or thithucdientu.gov.vn: the Immigration Department warns that unofficial sites may charge fees not authorised by Vietnamese regulations.

Enter your full name (surname, middle and given names) exactly as it appears on the ICAO line of your passport, in capital letters. With an e-visa you must enter and leave Viet Nam through the international border gates designated by the Government, though not necessarily the same one.

Canada's travel advice says road safety is poor and fatal accidents frequently involve motorcycles, that you need a valid Vietnamese driver's licence for any vehicle of 50cc or more, including most motorcycles, that motorcycle riders and passengers must wear a helmet, and that there is zero tolerance for drinking and driving; the UK Foreign Office says British drivers need a 1968 International Driving Permit with their UK licence.

faq.question: Do US citizens need a visa for Vietnam?
faq.answer: US passport holders are not among the visa-exempt nationalities in the government resolutions we read, and Vietnam issues e-visas to citizens of all countries — 25 USD single entry or 50 USD multiple entry, valid up to 90 days — at evisa.gov.vn (or thithucdientu.gov.vn). Processing typically takes 3 working days, or 3 to 15 when the application needs verification.

faq.question: Which nationalities can enter Vietnam without a visa?
faq.answer: Government resolutions exempt citizens of the UK, Germany, France, Italy, Spain, Denmark, Sweden, Norway, Finland, Japan, South Korea and Russia from visas for stays of 45 days from entry, from 15 March 2025 to 14 March 2028; and citizens of Belgium, Bulgaria, Croatia, Czechia, Hungary, Luxembourg, the Netherlands, Poland, Romania, Slovakia, Slovenia and Switzerland for 45 days for tourism under the Tourism Stimulus Program, from 15 August 2025 to 14 August 2028. No official page we could read lists the other exemptions.

faq.question: How much does the Vietnam eVisa cost and how long does it take?
faq.answer: The e-visa costs 25 USD for single entry or 50 USD for multiple entry, is valid for up to 90 days, and is typically processed within 3 working days, or 3 to 15 working days when the application needs verification (working days exclude weekends and public holidays). It is available to citizens of all countries and territories.

faq.question: Can I extend my stay in Vietnam?
faq.answer: No official source we could read describes extending an e-visa. The e-visa portal says e-visas are not issued to foreigners already in Viet Nam, and that e-visa holders in Viet Nam may be eligible for a new visa if invited or guaranteed by an authority, organization or individual in Viet Nam.

faq.question: Does Vietnam require an arrival card or customs declaration?
faq.answer: The UK Foreign Office says that since 15 April 2026 foreign nationals arriving at Tan Son Nhat Airport in Ho Chi Minh City are encouraged to complete a digital arrival card online before arrival; it is not currently mandatory, but this may change or extend to other airports with limited notice. It says you must declare cash over 15 million dong or 5,000 US dollars.

faq.evisa-cost-time.text: E-visa fee: 25 USD for a single-entry visa / 50 USD for a multiple-entry visa.
Viet Nam e-Visa is valid for a maximum of 90 days
Electronic visas are typically processed within 03 working days (*) after the electronic visa fee has been paid with complete and valid information.
If the application needs to be verified by the Police Department, you will receive the results within 03 to 15 working days (*).
(*) Working days do not include weekends and public holidays.
Từ 15/8/2023, thực hiện cấp thị thực điện tử cho công dân tất cả các nước, vùng lãnh thổ.

faq.extend-stay.text: Electronic visas are issued to foreigners who wish to enter Vietnam (not applicable to foreigners currently residing in Vietnam).
e-Visa holders in Viet Nam may be eligible to apply for a new visa if invited or guaranteed by an authority, organization, or individual in Viet Nam

faq.arrival-card.text: From 15 April 2026, all foreign nationals entering Vietnam via Tan Son Nhat Airport (SGN), Ho Chi Minh City, are encouraged by the Vietnamese Government to complete a digital arrival card online before arrival.

The digital arrival card system is not currently a mandatory requirement for entry into Vietnam via Tan Son Nhat airport, but this may change, or be rolled out to other airports in Vietnam with limited notice.
If you’re taking cash into or out of Vietnam, you must declare amounts over: 15 million Vietnamese dong 5,000 US dollars

tips.evisa-scams.text: please access Viet Nam's electronic visa information page at the following addresses: https://evisa.gov.vn or https://thithucdientu.gov.vn to complete the procedure. Make sure to visit the correct website to avoid accessing unofficial electronic information pages, which may result in unauthorized fees according to Viet Nam's regulations.

tips.evisa-details.text: You need to provide your full name, including your surname, middle name, and given name, exactly as it appears on the ICAO line in your passport, using uppercase letters.

Foreigners using an electronic visa are not required to exit Vietnam through the same border gate where they entered. Note that foreigners must enter and exit Vietnam through international border gates designated by the government

tips.traffic.text: Road safety is poor throughout the country.
Fatal accidents are frequent. They frequently involve motorcycle
You must hold a valid Vietnamese driver's licence to drive a vehicle with an engine of 50CC or more. This includes most motorcycles. Motorcycle drivers and passengers must wear a helmet.
The country has a zero-tolerance policy for drinking and driving or cycling.
You’ll need to have both the 1968 version of the international driving permit and your UK driving licence with you whilst driving a car or motorbike in Vietnam.

entryRequirements.passportValidity.text: the validity of the electronic visa must be at least 30 days shorter than the passport validity.

entryRequirements.customs.currencyLimits.text: Cá nhân khi nhập cảnh qua các cửa khẩu quốc tế của Việt Nam bằng hộ chiếu mang theo ngoại tệ tiền mặt, đồng Việt Nam tiền mặt trên mức quy định dưới đây phải khai báo Hải quan cửa khẩu: 5.000 USD hoặc các loại ngoại tệ khác có giá trị tương đương; 15.000.000 đồng VNĐ

entryRequirements.customs.notes.0.text: If you’re taking prescription medication into Vietnam, carry it in your hand luggage with a copy of the prescription. If it has a total import value greater than 100 US dollars, you must declare it at customs.

entryRequirements.customs.notes.1.text: Vapes and related products are banned. You cannot buy vapes in Vietnam or bring them into the country.

entryRequirements.customs.notes.2.text: ensure you have the proper exportation permits from the Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism and the Vietnam General Department of Customs

countryFacts.safety.text: Violent crime against foreigners is rare, however petty crimes such as theft and pickpocketing occur regularly.
